name: Aswang
summary: Cannot kill players inside official hiding spots, but marks the spot for its next hunt.
clues: Hiding in an official closet/locker ends the hunt if it paths to you
Next hunt beelines straight to that marked hiding spot
Accelerates faster than normal during line-of-sight

conditional.text: Accelerates faster than standard ghosts with line-of-sight, reaching up to 2.53 m/s.

strength: Gains line-of-sight speed faster than most ghosts and remembers hiding spots that saved you.
weakness: Cannot kill you inside an official hiding spot (closet/locker); reaching you there immediately ends the hunt.

abilities.text: If it paths directly to a player inside an official hiding spot, it cannot kill them and ends the hunt immediately.
Ending a hunt on a hiding spot places a waypoint on that location for the next hunt.

hunt.text: Beelines toward the previously marked hiding spot at the start of the next hunt, even during the grace period.
Reaches 2.53 m/s max line-of-sight speed faster than standard ghosts.

detection: Hide inside an official closet or locker during a hunt; if the ghost walks right up to you and the hunt abruptly ends, it is an Aswang.
Do not reuse that same hiding spot on the next hunt, as it will rush straight there at hunt start.

notes.text: Only official hiding spots (closets, lockers) trigger the hunt-ending mechanic; improvised furniture hiding spots do not.

name: Banshee
summary: Stalks a single target at a time and has a unique wail on the Parabolic Microphone.
clues: Unique Banshee scream on the Parabolic Microphone
Ignores non-target players during hunts
Roams toward its target outside of hunts

huntThreshold.notes: Checks only the current target's sanity, not team average.

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Focuses on one player at a time, roaming to them and hunting based on their individual sanity.
weakness: Produces a distinctive wail on the Parabolic Microphone more frequently.

abilities.text: Selects one living player as its target; if the target dies or leaves, it picks a new target.
Frequently roams toward its target's location when not hunting.
Has a 33% chance to emit a unique Banshee scream instead of a normal paranormal sound on the Parabolic Microphone.

events.text: Prefers singing ghost events, which drain 15% sanity from the target instead of 10%.

hunt.text: Only chases and kills its current target if the target is inside the investigation area; other players can walk through it safely.
If the target is outside the house during a hunt, it hunts normally and can kill anyone.

detection: Listen with a Parabolic Microphone or Sound Sensor for the unique high-pitched Banshee wail.
In multiplayer, have players stand in different spots during a hunt (with incense ready) to see if it completely ignores everyone except one person.

notes.text: If the target is outside the building, a Banshee will behave like a normal ghost and kill other players.

name: Dayan
summary: Speeds up when nearby players move and slows down when they stand completely still.
clues: Speeds up if players within 10 m are moving
Slows down when nearby players stand completely still
Always uses a female ghost model

huntThreshold.notes: Depends on player movement near the ghost.

conditional.text: Becomes noticeably faster when players within ~10 m are moving.
Slows down when nearby players stand completely still.

strength: Punishes players who try to outrun or loop it while in motion.
weakness: Slows down significantly when nearby players stop moving.

abilities.text: Movement-reactive speed: nearby player movement accelerates it, while stillness slows it.

events.text: Always spawns with a female ghost model and name.

hunt.text: During a hunt, its footsteps noticeably speed up when you move within 10 m and slow down when you stand still.

detection: During a hunt, stand still while it is within ~10 m (behind cover) and listen to its footsteps, then take a few steps and listen for an immediate speed-up.
Rule out Dayan immediately if the ghost uses a male model.

notes.text: Exact m/s values for its moving vs. still states are not yet confirmed on all wikis.

unverified: Exact m/s speed values for moving vs still states

name: Deildegast
summary: Starts hunts at 3.0 m/s, slowing down by 0.1 m/s for each unique non-equipment item moved.
clues: Starts hunts extremely fast (3.0 m/s) if nothing was disturbed
No line-of-sight speed-up
Slows down by 0.1 m/s per unique non-equipment item moved since last hunt

conditional.text: Starts at 3.0 m/s and drops by 0.1 m/s per unique non-equipment item moved by players (down to 0.4 m/s at 26 items).
Does not gain line-of-sight acceleration.

strength: Extremely fast (3.0 m/s) at the start of a hunt if players have not disturbed household items.
weakness: Moving non-equipment items slows its next hunt, and it has no line-of-sight speed-up.

abilities.text: Speed resets to 3.0 m/s at the start of every new hunt, reduced by 0.1 m/s per unique non-equipment item interacted with since the previous hunt.

hunt.text: Constant speed throughout a hunt with zero line-of-sight acceleration.

detection: Listen to its speed on a fresh hunt (3.0 m/s), then deliberately move 10–15 household props (cups, plates, shoes) and listen on the next hunt to confirm it slowed down.
Check if it fails to speed up when chasing you in line-of-sight.

notes.text: Player equipment does not count toward the 0.1 m/s reduction; only non-equipment map props count.

name: Demon
summary: Hunts at 70% sanity, can hunt at any sanity via ability, and has shorter hunt cooldowns.
clues: Hunts at 70% sanity (or any sanity with its ability)
20 s minimum hunt cooldown instead of 25 s
Incense only blocks hunts for 60 s instead of 90 s

huntThreshold.notes: Normal hunts at 70% sanity; rare ability can trigger a hunt at any sanity.

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Hunts early, often, and recovers from smudge sticks faster than other ghosts.
weakness: Crucifix effective range is increased by 50% (e.g., 4.5 m for Tier 1, 6 m for Tier 2, 7.5 m for Tier 3).

abilities.text: Can randomly initiate a hunt regardless of team sanity.

hunt.text: Minimum cooldown between hunts is 20 seconds (others: 25 s).
Incense prevents hunts for only 60 seconds (others: 90 s).

detection: Time the gap between a smudge/hunt end and the next hunt: 20–24 s or 60–89 s after smudging confirms Demon.
If a hunt starts above 70% sanity without cursed possessions, it is a Demon.

notes.text: Thaye at full age can hunt at 75% sanity, so check smudge/hunt cooldowns to distinguish them.

name: Deogen
summary: Always knows where every player is, rushes at 3.0 m/s from afar, and slows to 0.4 m/s up close.
clues: You cannot hide from it; it always knows your location
3.0 m/s at >6 m distance, slows to 0.4 m/s within 2.5 m
Unique heavy breathing response on Spirit Box within 1 m

conditional.text: Moves at 3.0 m/s when >6 m from its target.
Slows down to 0.4 m/s when within 2.5 m of its target.

strength: Always knows where all players are during a hunt, making hiding impossible.
weakness: Moves extremely slowly (0.4 m/s) when close to its target, making it easy to loop.

abilities.text: 33% chance to give a unique heavy breathing/bull-like sound on the Spirit Box when standing within 1 m of it.

hunt.text: Ignores hiding spots and paths directly to the nearest player.

detection: During a hunt, listen for very fast footsteps approaching that suddenly drop to a crawl as it gets close, then walk around a table or island to loop it.
Stand within 1 m of the ghost and ask Spirit Box questions for the unique heavy breathing.

notes.text: Spirit Box is forced on Nightmare and Insanity.

name: Gallu
summary: Cycles between Normal, Enraged, and Weakened states when interacting with protective equipment.
clues: Three states: Normal (50%), Enraged (60%), Weakened (40%)
Crucifixes, salt, and incense can shift its state
Speed and aggression change with its current state

conditional.text: Speed shifts dynamically between its Normal, Enraged (faster), and Weakened (slower) states.

strength: Becomes enraged with a higher hunt threshold (60%) and faster speed after certain defensive interactions.
weakness: Can enter a weakened state (40% hunt threshold, slower speed) depending on protective item interactions.

abilities.text: Burning a crucifix, being smudged with incense, or stepping in salt can trigger a state transition.

hunt.text: Hunt speed and threshold reflect whichever state (Normal, Enraged, Weakened) it is currently in.

detection: Observe whether its hunt speed or sanity threshold shifts after burning a crucifix, stepping in salt, or being smudged.

notes.text: Exact m/s values for Enraged and Weakened states are still being documented.

unverified: Exact m/s values for Enraged and Weakened states

name: Goryo
summary: D.O.T.S. silhouettes are only visible through a Video Camera when no player is in the ghost room.
clues: D.O.T.S. only visible on Video Camera with no one in the room
Never changes its favourite room
Rarely roams far from its room

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Rarely leaves its favourite room and hides its D.O.T.S. state from players standing inside.
weakness: Never changes its favourite room, even on higher difficulties.

abilities.text: Cannot enter D.O.T.S. state while any player is in the same room.
D.O.T.S. silhouette can only be seen through a Video Camera, not with the naked eye.

hunt.text: Standard hunt behaviour.

detection: Place a Video Camera aimed at the D.O.T.S. Projector, leave the room, and watch from the van or hallway.
If you see D.O.T.S. with the naked eye or while someone is in the room, rule out Goryo.

notes.text: D.O.T.S. Projector is forced on Nightmare and Insanity.

name: Hantu
summary: Moves faster in cold rooms, emits freezing breath during hunts, and cannot turn on the breaker.
clues: Visible freezing breath from its mouth during hunts when breaker is off
Faster in cold rooms (up to 2.7 m/s), slower in warm rooms (1.4 m/s)
Never turns the fuse box on; has no line-of-sight speed-up

conditional.text: 1.4 m/s in warm rooms (>=15°C) up to 2.7 m/s in freezing rooms (<0°C).
Does not gain line-of-sight acceleration.

strength: Moves very fast in cold rooms and throughout the house when the fuse box is off.
weakness: Moves slowly in warm rooms and never turns the fuse box on.

abilities.text: Cannot turn the fuse box on, and has double the chance to turn it off.

hunt.text: Emits visible freezing breath from its mouth during hunts if the fuse box is off.

detection: Turn off the fuse box and look for freezing breath coming from the ghost's mouth during a hunt.
Listen for its speed dropping noticeably when it leaves its cold ghost room into a warm hallway.

notes.text: Freezing Temperatures is forced on Nightmare and Insanity.

name: Jinn
summary: Sprints at 2.5 m/s toward distant players in line-of-sight when the fuse box is on, and never turns it off.
clues: 2.5 m/s in line-of-sight when >3 m away and fuse box is on
Never turns the fuse box off
Ability drains 25% sanity near it and leaves EMF at the fuse box

conditional.text: Instantly moves at 2.5 m/s when the fuse box is on, it has line-of-sight, and the target is >3 m away.

strength: Closes long distances rapidly when the fuse box is on.
weakness: Cannot use its speed or sanity-drain ability if the fuse box is off, and never turns the fuse box off.

abilities.text: Can drain 25% sanity from players within 3 m (or in the same room) while leaving EMF 2/5 at the fuse box.
Cannot turn the fuse box off directly (tripping it by turning on too many lights still works).

hunt.text: Drops back to 1.7 m/s once within 3 m of its target.

detection: Keep the fuse box on and check for EMF at the fuse box without it turning off.
During a hunt with the breaker on, watch if it immediately sprints at 2.5 m/s down a long hallway when it sees you.

notes.text: If the ghost ever turns the fuse box off directly, it cannot be a Jinn.

name: Kormos
summary: A visually blind ghost that hunts by sound, hearing sprinting from up to 30 m away.
clues: Visually blind; tracks players by sound instead of line-of-sight
Hears crouching (~10 m), walking (~15 m), and sprinting (~30 m)
Hunt threshold rises to 70% if a player sprints nearby

huntThreshold.notes: 50% default; increases to 70% if a player sprints near the ghost.

conditional.text: Accelerates up to 2.21 m/s when tracking player noise.

strength: Detects footsteps and electronics from far away and hunts early (70%) if players sprint near it.
weakness: Visually blind; crouching and staying silent makes it much harder for it to find you.

abilities.text: Sprinting near the ghost raises its hunt threshold to 70%.

hunt.text: Tracks players by sound: ~10 m crouched, ~15 m walking, ~30 m sprinting.

detection: Stay crouched and silent in view of it (with incense ready) to test if it fails to see you visually.
Sprint near its room at 50–70% sanity to see if it triggers an early hunt.

notes.text: Active electronics still give away your position.

name: Mare
summary: Hunts at 60% in the dark, 40% in the light, and can immediately flick lights back off.
clues: Hunts at 60% in unlit rooms, 40% in lit rooms
Can instantly turn a light switch off right after you turn it on
Never turns a light switch on

huntThreshold.notes: Based on whether the light in the ghost's current room is on or off.

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: More likely to hunt in the dark and frequently breaks or turns off lights.
weakness: Keeping lights on lowers its hunt threshold to 40%.

abilities.text: Has a chance to immediately turn off a light switch within ~4 m right after a player turns it on (10 s cooldown per player).
Cannot turn a light switch on.

events.text: Higher chance to perform light-breaking ghost events.

hunt.text: Standard hunt behaviour.

detection: Flip the light switch in the ghost room on and wait 1–2 seconds to see if it immediately flicks it back off.
If the ghost ever turns a light on, rule out Mare.

notes.text: Monitor/TV screens and candles do not count as room lights for the Mare's threshold.

name: Moroi
summary: Curses players via Spirit Box/Parabolic Mic and moves faster as average sanity drops.
clues: Speed scales from 1.5 m/s (high sanity) to 2.25 m/s (0% sanity)
Spirit Box or Parabolic Mic response curses you (double sanity drain)
Incense blinds it for 7.5 s instead of 5 s during hunts

conditional.text: Base speed increases as average team sanity drops, reaching 2.25 m/s at 0% sanity (and up to 3.71 m/s with LOS).

strength: Becomes the fastest line-of-sight ghost at 0% sanity and curses players who hear it.
weakness: Incense blinds it for 7.5 seconds during a hunt instead of 5 seconds.

abilities.text: Curses any player who gets a Spirit Box response or hears a paranormal sound on the Parabolic Mic, doubling passive sanity drain.

hunt.text: Blinded by incense for 7.5 s (others: 5 s).

detection: Check if its hunt speed noticeably increases as your team's sanity drops (or after taking Sanity Medication, which slows it down).
Time how long it wanders blindly after being smudged during a hunt (7.5 s).

notes.text: Spirit Box is forced on Nightmare and Insanity. Taking Sanity Medication cures the curse.

name: Myling
summary: Footsteps and vocals are only audible within 12 m during hunts, and it makes frequent Parabolic Mic sounds.
clues: Hunt footsteps are only audible within 12 m (others: 20 m)
Flashlight flickers at 10 m, almost the same time you hear footsteps
Makes more frequent paranormal sounds on the Parabolic Microphone

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Much quieter during hunts, making it harder to hear approaching.
weakness: Produces paranormal sounds more frequently on the Parabolic Microphone.

abilities.text: Higher frequency of paranormal sounds on the Parabolic Microphone.

hunt.text: Footsteps and vocalizations are only audible within 12 m (normal ghosts: 20 m).

detection: Drop a lit flashlight on the floor and stand next to it during a hunt: if the flashlight flickers before or at the exact moment you hear footsteps, it is a Myling.

notes.text: On different floors, footsteps can sound muffled for any ghost—test on the same floor.

name: Obake
summary: Shapeshifts briefly during hunts, can leave 6-fingered handprints, and may skip leaving UV.
clues: Briefly shapeshifts into another ghost model once per ~12–27 blinks during a hunt
16.7% chance to leave a 6-fingered handprint (or 2-fingered light switch / 5-fingered keyboard)
25% chance to not leave UV evidence on an interaction

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Can hide its UV evidence 25% of the time and halve the duration of existing UV prints.
weakness: Shapeshifts during hunts and occasionally leaves unique 6-fingered handprints.

abilities.text: 25% chance to leave no UV print on a UV-eligible interaction.
16.7% chance to leave a 6-fingered handprint, 2-fingered light switch print, or 5-fingered keyboard/prison bars print.

hunt.text: Guaranteed to shapeshift into another ghost model for one blink at least once per hunt (around every 12–27 blinks).

detection: Watch the ghost's model during a hunt (from a safe looping spot or smudge range) for a single-frame model swap.
Check UV handprints on doors for 6 fingers.

notes.text: Ultraviolet is forced on Nightmare and Insanity.

name: Obambo
summary: Cycles between Calm (10% hunt, 1.45 m/s) and Aggressive (65% hunt, 1.96 m/s) every 2 minutes.
clues: Swaps between Calm and Aggressive states every 2 minutes
Calm: 10% hunt threshold, 1.45 m/s speed
Aggressive: 65% hunt threshold, 1.96 m/s speed (can swap mid-hunt)

huntThreshold.notes: 10% in Calm state, 65% in Aggressive state.

conditional.text: 1.45 m/s in Calm state; 1.96 m/s in Aggressive state.
Can swap states mid-hunt on its 2-minute timer.

strength: Can suddenly hunt at 65% sanity and move at 1.96 m/s during its Aggressive phase.
weakness: Only hunts at 10% sanity and moves slowly (1.45 m/s) during its Calm phase.

abilities.text: Switches between Calm and Aggressive states on a fixed 2-minute timer regardless of player actions.

hunt.text: Speed can abruptly shift between 1.45 m/s and 1.96 m/s mid-hunt if the 2-minute timer ticks over.

detection: Listen for an abrupt mid-hunt speed change between 1.45 m/s and 1.96 m/s, or notice hunts alternating between 65% and 10% sanity.
Do not confuse its mid-hunt speed shift with The Twins (which only change speed between hunts, not mid-hunt).

notes.text: Unlike The Twins, Obambo's speed can change during a single hunt.

name: Oni
summary: Very active around players, drains 20% sanity on ghost events, and never does the airball event.
clues: Never performs the ghost mist (airball) event
More visible during hunts (shorter invisible blinks)
Drains 20% sanity on ghost event collision (others: 10%)

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Very active when players are nearby and drains double sanity (20%) on ghost event hits.
weakness: Much easier to see during hunts due to shorter invisible blink intervals, and cannot do airball events.

abilities.text: Cannot perform the ghost mist (airball) event.
Prefers full-form ghost events over shadow/translucent forms.

events.text: Ghost events drain 20% sanity instead of 10%.

hunt.text: Remains visible for longer between blinks during a hunt.

detection: If you see a ghost mist (airball) event, immediately rule out Oni.
Watch its blinking during a hunt—it looks almost solid compared to other ghosts.

notes.text: Blinking is the opposite of Phantom (which is mostly invisible).

name: Onryo
summary: Hunts at 60% sanity, is blocked by lit firelights, and always hunts after blowing out 3 flames.
clues: Every 3rd firelight blown out triggers a hunt (at any sanity)
Lit firelights act like a 4 m crucifix and block hunts
Hunts at 60% sanity

huntThreshold.notes: 60% average team sanity, or any sanity on every 3rd blown-out flame.

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Extinguishing three flames forces an immediate hunt regardless of sanity.
weakness: Lit firelights prevent it from hunting within 4 m (prioritized over crucifixes).

abilities.text: Every 3rd flame extinguished by the Onryo attempts to start a hunt (blocked if another lit flame or crucifix is within 4 m).

hunt.text: Standard hunt behaviour.

detection: Place 3–4 lit firelights on top of a crucifix in the ghost room; if it blows out 3 flames and immediately burns the crucifix, it is an Onryo.

notes.text: Dead players' flames do not count; only map/equipment firelights.

name: Phantom
summary: Disappears when photographed, roams to random players, and is mostly invisible during hunts.
clues: Taking a photo of it makes it vanish (and leaves no distortion in the photo)
Mostly invisible during hunts (long 1–2 s invisible blinks)
Roams to a random player, leaving EMF 2 at their location

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Looking at a Phantom during a ghost event or hunt drains sanity faster (0.5%/s).
weakness: Taking a photo of it during a ghost event makes it disappear immediately.

abilities.text: Can choose a random player and walk directly to them, leaving EMF 2.

events.text: Photographing it during a ghost event causes it to vanish immediately while the event audio continues, and the photo shows no ghost or distortion.

hunt.text: Invisible for 1–2 seconds between blinks during hunts.

detection: Take a photo during a ghost event; if it vanishes and the photo is clear, it is a Phantom.
Watch its blinking during a hunt—it is barely visible.

notes.text: A D.O.T.S. photo also counts for making it vanish.

name: Poltergeist
summary: Throws multiple objects at once in an explosion and throws objects every 0.5 s during hunts.
clues: Multi-throw ability blasts several nearby items at once (drains 2% sanity per item)
100% chance to throw an object in range every 0.5 s during a hunt
Throws objects harder and farther than other ghosts

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Can throw multiple objects simultaneously and drain team sanity quickly.
weakness: Becomes powerless in an empty room with nothing to throw.

abilities.text: Can throw multiple objects at once, draining 2% sanity per thrown object from nearby players.

hunt.text: Throws any nearby object every 0.5 seconds with 100% probability (others: 50%).

detection: Build a pile of 6–10 items in the ghost room; if it explodes the pile at once (or scatters it rapidly during a hunt), it is a Poltergeist.

notes.text: Multi-throws can happen outside hunts and leave EMF 2/3.

name: Raiju
summary: Hunts at 65% near active electronics and moves at 2.5 m/s within range of powered equipment.
clues: 2.5 m/s when within 6/8/10 m (small/medium/large map) of active player electronics
Hunts at 65% sanity when near active electronics
Disrupts electronics from 15 m away instead of 10 m

huntThreshold.notes: 65% when near active player equipment; 50% otherwise.

conditional.text: 2.5 m/s when near active player electronics (6 m small, 8 m medium, 10 m large maps).

strength: Moves at 2.5 m/s and hunts earlier around active player equipment.
weakness: Disrupts electronics from 15 m away, giving away its approach earlier.

abilities.text: Draws power from active player electronics (excluding head-mounted gear when off, and map appliances).

hunt.text: Speeds up to 2.5 m/s whenever passing active equipment.

detection: Leave an active flashlight or D.O.T.S. in a hallway and listen during a hunt for a sudden burst to 2.5 m/s only while passing that spot.

notes.text: Thrown/dropped active flashlights, EMF readers, and Video Cameras all power the Raiju.

name: Revenant
summary: Crawls at 1.0 m/s when idle, but sprints at 3.0 m/s as soon as it detects a player.
clues: 1.0 m/s when it has not detected any player
Instantly 3.0 m/s when it sees or hears a player or active electronics
Stays at 3.0 m/s until reaching the last known location, then slows back to 1.0 m/s

conditional.text: Instantly 3.0 m/s when it detects a player (sight, voice, or electronics).

strength: Extremely fast (3.0 m/s) when chasing a detected player.
weakness: Very slow (1.0 m/s) when it cannot detect anyone.

abilities.text: No special non-hunt abilities.

hunt.text: Slows down gradually back to 1.0 m/s after reaching the player's last known position.

detection: Hide silently during a hunt; if the footsteps are unmistakably slow (1.0 m/s) and then suddenly explode to 3.0 m/s if you flash a light or speak, it is a Revenant.

notes.text: Unlike Deogen, Revenant is slow when far/unseen and fast when it detects you.

name: Shade
summary: Shy ghost that hunts at 35% sanity and will not hunt or do EMF 3/writing while a player is in its room.
clues: Hunts at 35% sanity
Cannot hunt if a player is in the same room
Does not throw objects, write, or blow out candles while a player is in its room

huntThreshold.notes: 35% average team sanity; blocked if a player is in the same room.

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Harder to find because it stops most interactions when players are in its room.
weakness: Cannot hunt at all if a player is standing in the same room, and hunts only at 35% sanity.

abilities.text: Higher chance to appear as a shadow form during ghost events.

events.text: Ghost event chance scales inversely with average sanity (0% at 100% sanity, 100% at <=50% sanity).

hunt.text: Cannot start a hunt while any living player is in the same room.

detection: Sit in the ghost room below 35% sanity; if it only hunts or interacts after you step out into the hallway, it is a Shade.

notes.text: It can still roam to an adjacent room and start a hunt from there.

name: Spirit
summary: A standard ghost whose only tell is that incense blocks it from hunting for 180 seconds.
clues: Incense prevents hunts for 180 seconds (others: 90 s, Demon: 60 s)
Standard 50% hunt threshold and 1.7 m/s speed
No unique hunt or event tells

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: No notable strengths.
weakness: Incense stops it from hunting for 180 seconds (3 minutes).

abilities.text: No special abilities.

hunt.text: Standard hunt behaviour.

detection: Smudge the ghost at <=50% sanity and start a 3-minute timer; if it does not hunt between 90 s and 180 s, it is very likely a Spirit.

notes.text: If it hunts before 180 seconds after being smudged, rule out Spirit.

name: Thaye
summary: Starts young, fast (2.75 m/s), and aggressive (75% hunt), then ages when players are nearby.
clues: Ages every 1–2 minutes while a player is in its room (up to 10 times)
Young: 75% hunt, 2.75 m/s; Old: 15% hunt, 1.0 m/s
Has no line-of-sight speed-up

huntThreshold.notes: Starts at 75% and drops by 6% per age stage down to 15%.

conditional.text: Drops by 0.175 m/s per age stage from 2.75 m/s down to 1.0 m/s.
Does not gain line-of-sight acceleration.

strength: Very fast and hunts at 75% sanity at the start of the contract.
weakness: Weakens dramatically as it ages, eventually hunting only at 15% sanity and 1.0 m/s.

abilities.text: Attempts to age every 1–2 minutes; succeeds if at least one player is in the same room.

hunt.text: Constant speed during a hunt with zero line-of-sight acceleration.

detection: Compare its hunt speed early in the contract vs. after spending 5+ minutes in its room.
Ask its age on the Ouija Board twice, 2 minutes apart—if the age increases, it is a Thaye.

notes.text: Aging only progresses while a player is in the ghost's current room.

name: The Mimic

extraEvidence.text: Shows Ghost Orbs as a fake extra evidence, even on 0-evidence contracts.

summary: Copies another ghost's behaviour every 30–120 seconds and always produces fake Ghost Orbs.
clues: Shows fake Ghost Orbs even on 0-evidence contracts
Copies a different ghost's abilities, speed, and hunt threshold every 30–120 s
Cannot copy another ghost's evidence (except its own fake Orbs)

huntThreshold.notes: Copies the hunt threshold of whichever ghost it is currently mimicking.

conditional.text: Copies the base and conditional speed of the currently mimicked ghost.

strength: Unpredictable; can mimic Demon early hunts, Revenant speed, or Deo detection.
weakness: Always produces fake Ghost Orbs in addition to its 3 real evidence types.

abilities.text: Switches which ghost it mimics every 30–120 seconds (never mid-hunt).

events.text: Copies the ghost event behaviour of the mimicked ghost.

hunt.text: Copies the hunt speed, blink rate, and special hunt rules of the mimicked ghost.

detection: On 0-evidence contracts, finding Ghost Orbs immediately confirms The Mimic.
On 1–3 evidence contracts, if you see Ghost Orbs alongside Spirit Box, UV, or Freezing, check for the other Mimic evidence or inconsistent hunt speeds between hunts.

notes.text: Ghost Orbs do not count toward the difficulty's evidence limit.

name: The Twins
summary: Acts in two places at once and hunts at either 1.5 m/s (main) or 1.9 m/s (decoy).
clues: Main twin hunts at 1.5 m/s; decoy twin hunts at 1.9 m/s
Can interact in two separate rooms almost simultaneously
Hunt can start from the decoy's last interaction spot instead of the ghost room

conditional.text: 50% chance to hunt at 1.5 m/s (main) or 1.9 m/s (decoy), with standard LOS acceleration.

strength: Can start hunts from a decoy location outside the main ghost room.
weakness: Often interacts in two places at once and alternates between 1.5 m/s and 1.9 m/s hunts.

abilities.text: Can trigger an interaction in its room and another up to 16 m away within ~1 second.

hunt.text: Crucifixes only check the ghost's actual position, even if it decides to hunt from the decoy's spot.

detection: Listen for two different hunt speeds across separate hunts (slightly slower 1.5 m/s vs slightly faster 1.9 m/s).
Watch for activity spikes (twins curve) on the truck activity board or simultaneous interactions in two rooms.

notes.text: Speed only varies between hunts, never mid-hunt (unlike Obambo).

name: Wraith
summary: Never steps in salt and can teleport directly to a random player, leaving EMF 2.
clues: Never disturbs salt piles (zero footprints/salt steps)
Can teleport to a random player, leaving EMF 2 (or 25% EMF 5)
Teleporting can start a hunt right on top of a player

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Can teleport to any player anywhere on the map.
weakness: Never steps in salt, making it easy to rule out.

abilities.text: Can teleport within 3 m of a random player, generating EMF 2 (or 25% EMF 5).

hunt.text: Standard hunt behaviour.

detection: Place salt in doorways or chokepoints (or under a motion sensor); if the motion sensor triggers repeatedly without any salt being stepped in, it is a Wraith.

notes.text: If any ghost steps in salt, immediately rule out Wraith.

name: Yokai
summary: Hunts at 80% sanity if players talk nearby, but is nearly deaf/blind to electronics beyond 2.5 m during hunts.
clues: Hunts at 80% sanity if a player talks within 2 m of it
During hunts, only hears voices or detects active electronics within 2.5 m
Easy to test by speaking or flashing a light from >2.5 m away

huntThreshold.notes: 80% if a player speaks within 2 m of the ghost.

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Talking near it can trigger hunts as high as 80% sanity.
weakness: Only detects player voices and active electronics within 2.5 m during hunts.

abilities.text: Speaking within 2 m raises its hunt threshold to 80%.

hunt.text: Ignores voices and active electronics further than 2.5 m away.

detection: During a hunt, stand >2.5 m away (out of line-of-sight) and speak or toggle your flashlight; if it walks right past without turning toward you, it is a Yokai.

notes.text: Line-of-sight detection still works normally—only sound and electronics are limited to 2.5 m.

name: Yurei
summary: Can slam doors shut while draining 15% sanity, and incense traps it in its room for 90 seconds.
clues: Ability fully closes a door (including the front door outside a hunt) and drains 15% sanity
Incense traps it inside its current room for 90 seconds
Only ghost that can close the front door without a hunt or ghost event

conditional.text: Standard line-of-sight acceleration up to 2.8 m/s.

strength: Drains 15% sanity from nearby players when using its door-slamming ability.
weakness: Smudging it with incense prevents it from leaving its room for 90 seconds.

abilities.text: Can fully close an open door (with a slight delay before the click) and drain 15% sanity from players within 7.5 m.

hunt.text: Standard hunt behaviour.

detection: Watch for a door closing completely from fully open with a delayed click and no ghost event, especially the front door.
Smudge its room and place motion sensors outside the door—if it never leaves for 90 s, it may be a Yurei.

notes.text: Other ghosts can touch doors, but only Yurei's ability shuts a door all the way with the delayed sound.
